title: 特朗普不续签美墨加协定
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You saw the headline coming on USMCA, we wrote the story that people should expect it, but what does this mean now? People need to understand that this automatically renews
segments.zh: 你看到了USMCA的新闻，我们写了文章说大家应该预料到，但这意味着什么？人们需要明白，这个协议会自动续期

segments.en: without a renegotiation, but what does Jamis and Greer mean by this lengthy investigation will happen to this trade agreement? I was trying to decipher that as well. It sounds like the agreement
segments.zh: 无需重新谈判，但Jamis和Greer说要对这个贸易协议进行漫长调查，是什么意思？我也在琢磨。听起来协议

segments.en: stays in place for another 10 years and yet they will have a chance every year to tinker with it and that's what they didn't just agree in light today and that's a broader sign of the fact that
segments.zh: 会再维持10年，但每年都有机会调整，这就是他们今天没有达成一致的原因，也表明

segments.en: the president is not super happy with Canada, maybe a little happier with Mexico, but would like deals with each exclusively, right? Yeah, I think so.
segments.zh: 总统对加拿大不太满意，对墨西哥可能好一点，但希望分别与两国达成协议，对吧？是的，我也这么认为。

segments.en: I think so. And also would like to tinker with an agreement that he himself pushed through in 2020 and called one of the greatest trade deals of all time and yet now there are parts of it that he's
segments.zh: 而且他还想调整一个他自己在2020年推动通过、并称之为史上最伟大贸易协议之一的协议，但现在他对其中一些部分

segments.en: not happy with and doesn't want to endorse.
